description: Inspect any text character by character: code point, UTF-16 units, UTF-8 bytes, Unicode block and category — handles emoji and surrogate pairs correctly.

faqs.a: Type or paste any text. Each Unicode code point gets a row: the character, U+XXXX, UTF-16 code units, UTF-8 bytes, block and category.
Yes — it iterates by code point (not UTF-16 unit), so emoji like 😀 show as a single U+1F600 with its 4 UTF-8 bytes.
UTF-8 bytes are computed with the real encoding algorithm from the code point, and blocks come from the official Unicode range table.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Type or paste text into the input box.
Each character is broken down into code point, UTF-8 bytes and more.
Use it to debug invisible characters, emoji and encodings.
title: Unicode Inspector
